name: New Jersey

default_limits.basis: N.J.S.A. 39:4-98: 25 business/residential district, 35 suburban business/residential, 50 elsewhere. 65 only where designated and posted (39:4-98.3).

fine.notes: Payable totals from the Statewide Violations Bureau Schedule (Directive 15-20, 2020) include costs. Some town sites show $1 less. Statute: $50-$200, doubled at 20+ over. 40+ over: must appear in court.

court_costs.notes: Included in the payable amounts above. A 2008 court schedule listed court costs of up to $33 plus a $6 assessment.

zones.work_zone: Construction zones, safe corridors and 65 zones: $141 (1-9 over), $161 (10-14), $181 (15-19). 20+ over: must appear in court.
zones.school_zone: 25 mph statutory school-zone limit during recess or when children are present.

court.reason: Court appearance required at 40+ over (20+ over in 65, construction or safe-corridor zones). Fines doubled from 20+ over.

arrest.offense: None by speed alone. Reckless driving (39:4-96) is a motor-vehicle offense that requires reckless conduct.

notes: Speeding itself carries up to 15 days jail (39:4-104, per secondary source), but no criminal speed threshold was found. The current njcourts SVBS PDF wasn't reachable; Directive 15-20 is marked superseded, so verify the amounts. Reckless driving carries 5 points.
